deck_title: Enterprise Automotive Digital-Twin Global TVC & Weather Configurator Pipeline: OEM CAD Kinematic Rig + Dual-Layer Clearcoat PBR + 360-Degree Dynamic AI HDRI Dome (c_auto = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive I2V Wheel/Emblem Morphing

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Automotive Digital-Twin TVC & Weather Configurator evaluation (locking Class-A NURBS CAD body panels, non-rotating brake calipers, and Ackermann wheel kinematics at 0.00mm tolerance, shading with X-Rite measured dual-layer metallic Clearcoat PBR, inverse-estimating a 32-bit 360-degree dynamic LatLong HDRI dome from NVIDIA Cosmos / 3DGS regional backgrounds to drive velocity-locked specular reflections across the hood, and compositing tire rain-spray/dust wakes so amortized per-market TVC cost c_auto(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_auto = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive unconstrained I2V generation (which morphs 5-spoke wheels into 7-spoke blobs, spins brake calipers, and melts grille emblems, inflating CGI rework by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-solid-angle HDRI dome quadrature.

not_for: Feeding a static car photo into unconstrained Image-to-Video diffusion where wheels morph spokes, brake calipers spin, and panel gaps bend
Pasting an unlit static car cutout over a moving background without dynamic HDRI clearcoat reflections
Low-poly cartoon racing games that do not require OEM CAD accuracy
